verdict.rationale: skills.sh exposes a well-documented CLI (`npx skills add/use/list/update/remove/init`, non-interactive/CI-friendly flags) that lets automated/agentic callers drive it programmatically, and AGENTS.md/specification.md document the interface in detail. However, this is a CLI, not a public API/SDK, and a community member explicitly requests 'Please make a rest API!' ([skills-cli-comm-5]), indicating no such API exists yet. Missing for 10: a documented REST/programmatic API (not just CLI), SDKs or webhooks, and independent confirmation of API-level access beyond the CLI wrapper.
